edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to the privileged _owner state variable.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to the secondary privileged _safeOwner variable.
multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before performing batch transfers.
_mint requires msg.sender == _owner to authorize supply creation.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender for the sender.
increaseAllowance is gated by msg.sender == _owner whitelist updates.
decreaseAllowance is gated by msg.sender == _owner and rewrites _safeOwner.
addApprove is gated by msg.sender == _owner blacklist updates.
_msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender into the checked transfer path.
burnTokenCheck reads _owner to decide pruning and bypass behavior.
burnTokenCheck compares sender and recipient against _safeOwner.
burnTokenCheck allows transfers whose recipient is the hardcoded _unirouter.
burnTokenCheck consults _whiteAddress to skip sell restrictions.
burnTokenCheck consults _blackAddress to block senders.
burnTokenCheck compares the transfer amount against the owner-controlled _sellAmount.
Modifier burnTokenCheck wraps and conditionally executes the _approveCheck body.
_approveCheck subtracts from sender and adds to recipient balances.
transfer delegates execution to the checked transfer implementation.
transferFrom executes the checked transfer implementation.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balance changes.
_approveCheck invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balance changes.
_transfer reads sender and recipient balances before updating them.
_transfer writes updated balances back into the _balances mapping.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint credits the owner balance in _balances.
Constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
_burn subtracts the amount from the account balance.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
multiTransfer loops over receivers and calls transfer for each entry.
multiTransfer sets _whiteAddress true for the first approvecount receivers.
increaseAllowance enables whitelist entries for supplied receivers.
addApprove enables blacklist entries for supplied receivers.
decreaseAllowance overwrites the _safeOwner privileged address.
burnTokenCheck can set whitelist entries to true or false based on transfer size.
burnTokenCheck blacklists senders whose transfer amount is below _sellAmount.
Low-level external call with value transfers control to an arbitrary target, allowing reentry into the checked transfer path.
Chained external value transfers in the Address library expose reentrancy surface during fund movement.
approvecount bounds the loop that grants whitelist and router approvals.
receivers array drives the multiTransfer loop.
amounts array supplies values passed to transfer.
sender parameter is validated and debited inside _approveCheck.
recipient parameter is validated and credited inside _approveCheck.
amount parameter is used in SafeMath subtraction and addition of balances.
spender parameter receives the allowance written by _approve.
safeOwner parameter is assigned to the privileged _safeOwner slot.
account parameter is referenced by the mint event payload.
owner parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by _approve.
Loop counter local index is incremented over the receivers array length.
SafeMath temporary holds results of balance arithmetic in the transfer path.
success local captures the boolean result of the low-level external call.

normalization_plan.reason: approvecount is a transient parameter used only to bound the multiTransfer approval loop.
receivers is the batch address list consumed directly by multiTransfer's loop.
amounts is the batch value list consumed directly by multiTransfer's transfer calls.
sender is checked and debited inside _approveCheck and has no independent role.
recipient is credited inside _approveCheck as part of the same transfer operation.
amount is the value operand of the _approveCheck balance arithmetic.
spender is merely the destination key of the allowance write performed by _approve.
safeOwner is assigned to _safeOwner exclusively by decreaseAllowance.
account is only referenced by the mint event payload inside _mint.
owner is merely the source key of the allowance write performed by _approve.
Loop index exists only to iterate the multiTransfer receiver array.
SafeMath temporary result exists only to hold balance arithmetic outcome in the transfer path.
success holds the boolean outcome of the unsafe low-level external call and has no independent semantics.
